priority: RV02 breaks save round-trip; RV01 invalid creation; RV03 lost reset guard

findings.summary: Knave assigns mode to the preliminary type
findings.steps: Empty Knave 2e map, seed 1, generate 18-hex wild mainland region at (0,0). Inspect (1,3), save and reload.
findings.expected: exploration for roll 1; the dungeon row allows only exploration (40%) and interaction (60%).
findings.cause: src/App.tsx:14271 assigns discovery before :14274 finalizes the Knave type.
findings.done: Both profiles use the final realized type, preserve deterministic geography and regional RNG, retain authored values on type change.

findings.summary: Classic POIs on a map containing older Mythic regions fall back to passage
findings.steps: Import test/fixtures/import-v2/baseline-mythic.json (Classic selected). Generate next region (-2,12), wild mainland, size 18. Also add a cave at (-2,12) in the new region.
findings.actual: For all 5 new places in region 28 no shared mode was stored. Lair poi:28:-4,16 and manually added cave poi:28:-2,12 both fall back to passage.
findings.expected: Each newly added Classic place uses its table row; both cave and land lair have 0% passage. Existing Mythic locations need no migration.
findings.cause: src/App.tsx:1251 returns early for the entire map if any region is Mythic.
findings.done: Generate and add valid Classic modes on a mixed map, remove only deleted owners on delete; export/reopen, Undo and Redo must preserve valid documents and unrelated regions.
findings.impact: Сохранение после удаления авторской точки не открывается.
findings.deletion_steps: Give the cave at (-2,12) exploration in Classic, commit and delete that cave. Export the resulting map and open it through the ordinary import.
findings.import_error: map.poiDiscovery: invalid mode or missing place

findings.summary: Reset bypasses the existing confirmation for an imported authored Knave secret
findings.steps: Open the legacy Knave fixture with one region, one secret and no other protected annotations. Invoke Reset, configure window.confirm to return false if called.
findings.cause: src/App.tsx:15601 empties the old discoveryByPoi during import; :14670 still checks that old location.
findings.done: Preserve the opportunity to decline resetting the imported authored data. Verify declining leaves map and history intact, accepting and Undo restore the data. No requirement to prompt separately for every autogenerated value.

results.AC1: Classic capital and portal persisted. On one real map four manual creations matched rolls 19,20,54,55. Controls and exported JSON checked.
results.AC2: 41 × 100 expected outcomes matched. All six water types passed. Local place and projected portal preserved separate modes in one cell across reopening. Knave and mixed-map creation fail RV01/RV02.
results.AC3: Ordinary movable POI hidden in Classic, changed in Knave, moved across region in Classic, deleted, restored: exact Undo/Redo. The mixed-map case fails RV02. Capital relocation/deletion awaits owner decision; independent checks continued.
results.AC4: Two old-secret maps (empty comment and exact text with surrounding whitespace and newline), each opened in both profiles; clue discarded, shared mode preserved. Invalid mode and invalid owner refused without mutating live document or both history stacks. Mixed-map exported orphan and reset regression RV02/RV03.
results.AC5: Two successive areas per profile from seed 1 on baseline and candidate matched non-feature exported map fields and RNG. Repeat on candidate matched modes; checked exact SHA browser results and binary-matched 6 CI artifacts with committed evidence.

score_assessment.method: Prior ledger, Classic/Knave exact-SHA workflow and independent generated-map/import diagnostics. The shared capability is present. Creation violates its contract and one supported editing path yields an unreadable save.
score_assessment.limitations: Unpublished, no L2/L3 assessment. Reassess the corrective SHA before release and reconcile the deployed build after publication.

suites.scenario_risk: E6 water losses, Classic E7 transfer, Classic E8 move, E8 import, local edits, legacy Knave clue, Knave reroll identity.
One new real-map two-profile roundtrip capture, and changes to existing Knave lifecycle and one-mile projection.

test_change_summary.source: git diff b887422..449e6fe: logical test cases, rename counted as one modification; only Classic branches of parameterized E7/E8 changed.
test_change_summary.reuse_or_new_reason: Existing cases exercise distinct lifecycles; the new capture checks real-map UI and exported values. Gaps: final Knave type, mixed regions and declining reset of migrated data. Extend corresponding existing cases where possible.
